race.title: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com (Q.R.) Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: A thin maiden and in the hope he takes to hurdling at the first attempt, MARHABA GHAIYYATH may well be up to conceding weight all round given his Flat ability. Point recruit Legendary Status is the obvious alternative for Willie Mullins. MARHABA GHAIYYATH (IRE) LEGENDARY STATUS (IRE) QUINLAN (IRE)
